fomod.Name: MMO Hotbar
fomod.Author: MMOHotbar (fork of STB Hotkey System by STB)
fomod.Description: MMO-style 24-slot hotbar over a chord-based favorites hotkey core (full fork of STB Hotkey System, GPL-3.0-only). Slots 1-12 are keys 1..=, slots 13-24 are X+1..X+=. Bind from inventory/magic/favorites, stack groups, keycaps on rows. One SKSE DLL only.
